author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Dead Party, a new co-op game that brings together alien invasions, zombie hordes, and music-powered combat in a fast-paced party action game. On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood rises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders! Dead Party is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dead Party - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for Revenge of the Firstborn, a story-rich RPG based on the classic 3.5 SRD ruleset that blends narrative-driven exploration with strategic combat and deep party customization. Set in a world shaped by ancient curses and forgotten histories, players will uncover hidden truths while forging their path through danger and mystery. Revenge of the Firstborn is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Revenge of the Firstborn - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for I Can Only Speak Doner, a fast-paced cooking game where you play as an immigrant working in your uncle's doner shop. The catch is that you don't know the language of the country you immigrated to! Communicate with customers using the menu, learn the language, and use the money you earn to upgrade the doner shop. I Can Only Speak Doner will be available on PC via Steam on April 6, 2026.
title: I Can Only Speak Doner - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Neat, a cozy narrative puzzle game developed by Korova Games. You play as Molly, a 26-year-old professional organizer just starting her business. Each client sends her somewhere unexpected: a packed fridge, a bachelor's apartment, a musician's van, a car that doubles as someone's whole world. Neat is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Neat - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for Code Rapid, a Third-Person action mecha developed by HitBreak. On the distant world of Ondarea, war machines walk the planet long after the collapse. Discover decaying cities, snow-choked military outposts, and industrial relics of a lost age. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems. Code Rapid is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Code Rapid - Official Announcement Trailer
